title: AI Foundations for Product Teams
description: Build the vocabulary and mental models to work effectively with AI tools. No prior AI experience required.

title: AI Foundations for Engineers
description: Establish AI vocabulary, tool selection principles, and first structured prompts for engineering work.

title: AI-Enabled Product Work
description: Integrate AI into PRD authoring, backlog refinement, stakeholder communication, and test planning.

title: AI-Enabled Engineering
description: Use AI for code review, documentation, test generation, and structured output from engineering context.

title: AI-Enabled Design
description: Use AI to accelerate UX research synthesis, generate design specs, and describe interfaces in system language.

title: AI-Fluent: Workflow Design
description: Design reusable prompt chains, author skill packages, govern token costs, and build AI-ready context for agentic systems.

title: Skills & Tooling: What Actually Breaks
description: The quiet failure modes of AI skills and tooling: why a skill never loads, how to write a description that actually gets selected, whether a skill is a control you can evidence, and how to keep a document's format from outrunning its source.

title: AI-Native: System Design
description: Architect AI-first product systems. Build evaluation pipelines, define org AI strategy, and establish governance at scale.

title: AI Literacy for Leaders: Fund, Govern, Measure
description: Tier 4 literacy for directors and VPs — fund AI workflows, set risk-tier policy, and measure maturity by behavior. Explicitly not the architect track: you write the 'what', your architects build the 'how'.
